expectations.text: The response reports that the canonical credential is configured based only on the secure presence gate.
expectations.evidence: Credential configured is reported without exposing the value; executor confirmed the old secure gate.

expectations.text: The request uses POST https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v2/assets:search as a search-only operation with searchCategoryType Model and query tree, and identifies creator-store-product:read as the documented required scope.
expectations.evidence: The exact valid search operation, category, query, and scope appear.

expectations.text: The request is executed only through scripts/open_cloud_request.py with the required scope supplied, and no API key value or fragment is exposed.
expectations.evidence: The old helper has no `--required-scope` interface, so scope was not supplied to the helper boundary, though the key remained hidden.

expectations.text: For HTTP 403, the final answer names creator-store-product:read exactly, includes the literal URL https://create.roblox.com/dashboard/credentials?activeTab=ApiKeysTab, and directs the user to verify API operations, resource restrictions, IP restrictions, and key status.
expectations.evidence: The live response was HTTP 200, so this conditional 403 contract was not exercised.

expectations.text: No mutation or other side effect is performed.
expectations.evidence: Only search ran, no resource changed, and the temporary body was removed.

expectations.text: The user-facing prose and field labels are Japanese because the prompt is Japanese, while exact scope identifiers, URLs, HTTP tokens, and JSON fields remain untranslated.
expectations.evidence: All primary labels and prose are English (`Credential`, `Request`, `Result`, `Required permissions`, `Verification`, `Next`).

claims.evidence: Executor and final.md agree on the success and response fields.
